name: priest_of_kilmorph
description: a Priest of Kilmorph (Fall from Heaven), a stocky dwarf stonewarden with a long brown beard and brown hair, a long earth-brown robe with amber runes along the hem and a cream-trimmed front panel with an amber rune, a slate-grey stone mantle over the shoulders with amber runes and bronze clasps, brown boots, and a thick wooden staff topped with a carved grey rune-stone bearing an amber rune held upright in his LEFT hand (screen-right); his RIGHT hand (screen-left) is an empty fist at his waist
hands: the rune-stone staff stays upright in his left hand on the screen-right side and his right hand is an empty fist at his waist on the screen-left side

flinch.0: impact: hit from the lower-left; head snaps back toward the upper-right, eyes squeezed shut, torso jolts back, both arms jerk in tight (the staff arm drops straight down at his side, still gripping the rune-stone staff upright, his empty right fist clenched in front of his belly), the long beard swinging
flinch.1: recoil extreme: leaning back further toward the upper-right, knees bent, the rune-stone staff tilting across his body, its rune-stone top near his shoulder, his empty right fist still clenched at his belly

death.1: stagger back: a step back toward the upper-right, body thrown back, the staff arm flung up holding the rune-stone staff, his empty right fist drooping
death.2: knees buckle: hips drop, knees fold forward, torso slumps forward, head droops, the rune-stone staff lowering
death.3: kneeling: on both knees, slumped forward, the staff tilted with its grey rune-stone top resting on the ground at the lower-left, his empty right arm hanging
death.4: falling back: torso tips back toward the upper-right, the rune-stone staff slips out of the hand, legs slide forward, the brown robe flaring
death.5: hits the ground: lying on his back along the ground, feet toward the lower-left and head toward the upper-right, the stone mantle on his shoulders; the rune-stone staff lies on the ground at the lower-left
death.6: bounce: head and shoulders lift slightly off the ground, the long beard and the robe settle
death.7: corpse: lying flat and still on his back, eyes closed, the rune-stone staff on the ground beside him, its amber rune dimmed
